annotation.title_clean: 国家税务总局等9部门关于开展2026年助力小微经营主体发展“春雨润苗”专项行动的通知
annotation.title_en: Notice by the State Taxation Administration and 8 Other Departments on Launching the 2026 "Spring Rain Nourishing Seedlings" Special Action to Support the Development of Micro and Small Business Entities
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国家税务总局; 国家发展改革委; 科技部; 工业和信息化部; 人力资源社会保障部; 市场监管总局; 金融监管总局; 国家医保局; 全国工商联
annotation.summary_en: Chinese joint notice from nine bodies, led by the State Taxation Administration, launching the 2026 "Spring Rain" action. It sets 15 service measures for micro and small businesses: inter-agency coordination and data sharing, tax compliance guidance, credit and financing, support for key groups, technology innovation, cross-border business, rural revitalisation and green development. It has no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Launches 15 service measures in four focus areas for micro and small business entities
Builds inter-agency communication, data-sharing and demand-response mechanisms
Expands bank-tax interaction and credit repair support for financing
Supports entrepreneurship for key groups, individual-to-enterprise conversion and platform workers
Promotes tax incentives for technological innovation, cross-border business, rural and green development
